title: Grilled Tofu Skewers with Plum, Tomato, Corn, Feta & Cilantro Salad

steps.text: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
If using wooden skewers, place 8-12 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest one of the limes into a medium bowl (reserve zested lime for later use). Cut remaining lime into wedges and set aside for serving.
Add mayo and spices to the bowl with the lime zest, then whisk to combine the marinade.
Large dice tofu. Add to the bowl with the marinade and stir to coat.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, thread tofu onto skewers and place on a plate. (Alternatively, you can cook the tofu pieces directly on the pan without using skewers.)

Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Working in batches if necessary, add skewers and grill, turning occasionally, until the tofu is warmed through and charred in spots, about 8 minutes. Return to the plate.
Meanwhile, juice reserved lime into a clean medium bowl.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl with the lime juice along with oil, honey, salt, and crushed red pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Place corn in the colander and rinse under hot water (from the tap) to defrost. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve plums lengthwise (around the pit); twist halves to separate, then remove and discard pits. Cut each half into ¼-inch thick slices. Add to the bowl.
Halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and add the leaves to the bowl along with feta. Gently stir to combine the salad.
Divide skewers and salad between plates. Serve with lime wedges for squeezing and enjoy!
